notes: REGISTERED on 2026-08-20, on inbound #764, and deliberately not before: the consumer's own adoption PR (BWJ-ecommerce/xoxowildhearts#1) merged 2026-08-19 21:33Z, and this register records what a consumer HAS -- claiming a lens early makes check-connectors report 'registered extension(s) missing' and turns the register into a false alarm. Every field was measured against the consumer's own tree rather than taken from the report: 25 lens files under .claude/specialists/lenses/, matching these rosters exactly (19 + 3 + 3), the plugins enabled in .claude/settings.json against the github marketplace source, visibility private, and the local checkout present. 20 of the 25 lenses are still VUL-IN scaffolds -- present as FILES, which is what the roster check measures, and the intended state for a specialist with no work there yet. THE WORKFLOW SLOT IS REGISTERED as of 2026-08-21, on inbound #800, and the deferral that stood here was right while the answer it predicted was the losing one. It read: their in-flight branch feat-harness-hardening switches the slot to workflow-default, so registering either answer records a state about to change -- write the block once that branch has merged. It merged as PR #7 (merge commit bdf191a); ad315a1 did switch to workflow-default exactly as predicted, and the same day reversed it -- 463e091 'feat: adopt workflow-davekjohn -- the plugin holds the workflow slot', then 01a2723 'fix: disable workflow-default -- exactly one workflow holds the slot'. All four commits were read in the consumer's own history rather than taken from the report. Their .claude/settings.json on main now has workflow-default false and workflow-davekjohn true, and THE STATE HAS STOPPED MOVING is measured wider than main: all 16 remote branches carry workflow-davekjohn true, so nothing in flight moves it back. The empty extension list is the measured answer and not an un-filled one -- workflow-davekjohn ships no agents/ (its folder holds blueprint/, hooks/, scripts/, skills/, templates/ and the portable docs) -- the same answer, and the same wording, as connectors/smartwatchbanden.json. WHAT THE UNREGISTERED SLOT COST, which is why this is a registration and not a formality: check-connectors loops over the plugins THIS manifest lists, so an enabled plugin missing from that array is invisible to the version check. On 2026-08-21 a session-start [ERROR] named three drifted plugins for this consumer where four had drifted, and the one it could not name was workflow-davekjohn -- the plugin that ships connector-sessioncheck itself. Measured across all five connectors that day, this was the ONLY enabled-but-unregistered plugin anywhere, so registering it empties the class. The asymmetry is left standing rather than repaired: the analogous case one level down (a lens present but unregistered) already prints an [INVENTORY] line and the plugin level has none, and a risk whose population is now zero is written down rather than fixed. THE THREE DIFFERENCES THIS MANIFEST RECORDED HAVE ALL CLOSED, and they are corrected here rather than left standing, because a register whose purpose is to show what a consumer HAS cannot carry three claims it no longer has. Each was true when written on 2026-08-20 and each was overtaken by the very branch the slot note named as in-flight -- the same 'a stale line copied forward becomes a false line' shape the workflow's own folder page warns about. (1) 'No CHANGELOG.md at all, a flat update_log.txt with date headers and no ## sections': it has CHANGELOG.md now, 15 '##' sections and the workflow's own intro, and 8541994 'feat: replace update_log.txt with CHANGELOG.md on the plugin's mechanism' is the commit that did it. (2) 'It has not adopted workflow-davekjohn/': the folder is present and fully scaffolded (branch/, prompts/, releases/, README.md, CLAUDE.md, CONTRIBUTING.md). That also corrects the inbound #763 reading recorded here, which said the standing [ERROR] about a missing workflow-davekjohn/ folder had been answered by disabling the hook's own plugin -- they did the opposite and adopted the folder, which is the other way past that error and the one that keeps the workflow. (3) 'Lint gate pinned at --fail-level crash rather than error, because theme-check reports 1504 pre-existing offences across 171 files (1078 errors, 426 warnings)': ad315a1 moved it to '--fail-level error' and it is green -- five consecutive theme-check runs on 2026-08-21 all conclude success -- so the arithmetic that justified 'crash' no longer describes their gate. WHAT REMAINS TRUE is the reason this manifest was asked for: the register is where the two Shopify consumers diverging can be seen. What it records today is the opposite movement -- they converged, deliberately, and one of their branch names says so (tooling/align-with-smartwatchbanden). A MEASUREMENT NOTE, because it nearly wrote the wrong answer into this file: a first sweep of those 16 branches reported workflow-davekjohn true on NONE of them, main included, while the committed file plainly says true. Git Bash on Windows rewrites an argument that looks like a path, so 'origin/main:.claude/settings.json' reached git with its slash turned into a backslash and its colon into a semicolon, and every zero in that sweep was a fatal error being counted as an answer. MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 is the fix. A count is only as good as the command that produced it, and zero is the shape a broken command returns. CAUGHT UP 2026-08-27 (#978): the workflow plugin's id moved from 'workflow-davekjohn@' to 'contributing-davekjohn@' (source issue #886, commit 8797f7a5) and this record held the retired name. Measured against their live .claude/settings.json (GitHub API): team-alpha@, team-shopify@, team-ecomm@ and contributing-davekjohn@, all four enabled. The sentences above keep the name they were WRITTEN with, deliberately -- they are dated measurements down to the commit, and rewriting one to match today's names is the defect #952 was made of. WORTH READING TOGETHER WITH THE 2026-08-21 PARAGRAPH ABOVE, which measured the enabled-but-unregistered plugin as the only one anywhere and concluded that registering it 'empties the class'. That held for exactly five days: the rename re-opened the same blind spot by a different route -- not an unregistered plugin this time but a registered one under a name that no longer resolves, which check-connectors reports as [INFO] and then skips the block for. The class was never emptied, only its instance was. That is the reason the [INFO] stays an [INFO] rather than becoming an error: the population is not stable, and an error here would re-open the four false alarms of August 9, 2026.
